original_test_intent: Have a qualified operator inspect every BIOS IPv6 Network Configuration page and prove its owner-defined displayed information belongs to the complete expected IPv6-capable NIC/port inventory without changing network state.
original_method: Bind SUT/BIOS and the expected NIC topology; collect read-only PCIe/NIC/IPv6 evidence for mapping; traverse every BIOS IPv6 menu, capture its exact displayed fields, reconcile expected and displayed card/port sets and compare each field under the approved schema, then exit without saving.
manual_activity: The network owner supplies the complete card/port inventory and displayed-field oracle; a qualified operator traverses and captures every BIOS IPv6 page without changing settings.
required_inputs: Stable PCIe BDF, slot, port and MAC mapping
Owner-approved BIOS-displayed fields and expected values per entry
MAC/IPv6/endpoint redaction and protected evidence policy
safety_requirements: Do not change IPv6 enablement, addresses, DNS, gateway, VLAN, PXE, link or firmware settings
Do not assume placeholder MAC or OS enumeration order
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL
Protect MACs, IPv6 addresses, endpoints and host identity
Stop on missing/extra/duplicate/ambiguous entries or unexpected action prompt
agent_execution_scope: Collect optional read-only PCIe/NIC/port/IPv6 mapping evidence
Coordinate but do not claim BIOS UI traversal
Bind operator captures to stable card/port identity
Compare only fields defined by the approved BIOS schema
Report discrepancies without mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve complete topology, field/value criteria and redaction
Resolve disabled, link-down, extra or ambiguous entries

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its operator-only BIOS read is applicable but lacks the complete per-port identity and field oracle needed to prove all entries correct.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual operator: traverse every BIOS IPv6 Network Configuration entry, capture exact fields, bind each to the approved NIC/port topology and reconcile missing/extra/duplicate cards; use OS network data only for read-only mapping support.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-card IPv6 BIOS inspection and 20/20-minute estimates remain; no address or field is invented and log clearing is prohibited.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL COMPLETE BIOS IPV6-NIC INVENTORY RECONCILIATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-port matrix keyed by BDF/slot/port/redacted MAC with the approved BIOS field schema, captured values and optional OS corroboration, then reconcile set completeness before field correctness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a complete oracle, stable identity binding, privacy controls and bidirectional population checks while preserving read-only UI coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS `ip`/`ethtool`/PCIe evidence cannot replace BIOS page content; transient OS IPv6 values are not assumed to be expected BIOS values.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware menus may expose only preboot-stack fields and may omit disabled ports; the owner must define those presentation semantics.

project_override_considerations: Remote-console capture may assist but must show every BIOS entry. Network APIs or OS inventory remain supplementary unless explicit equivalence to the BIOS display requirement is approved.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS identity, complete NIC/port topology, approved field matrix and redaction policy
Protected BIOS IPv6 menu evidence for every displayed entry
Per-port stable identity and expected-versus-observed field comparison
Expected/displayed set reconciliation for missing, extra, duplicate, disabled and ambiguous entries
Optional complete read-only PCIe/NIC/IPv6 mapping and preserved events
No-mutation/no-save audit and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently request read-only IPv6 NIC information checks for all cards. Placeholder identity and missing field/inventory details are readiness inputs, not conflicting source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual comparison is deterministic once the owner supplies the complete topology, BIOS field oracle, operator and redaction policy.

review_improvement: Makes all-card coverage complete and identity-bound without inventing IPv6 fields or allowing network mutations during an inventory check.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BIOS entry labelled by MAC must be correlated to a stable physical port because OS names and transient IPv6 addresses can change. Set reconciliation catches missing/extra cards, while the owner-defined page schema prevents comparing unrelated OS runtime state as if it were firmware configuration evidence.
